settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Most orders ship within 1–2 business days and arrive within 3–7 business days depending on your location.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer free returns within 30 days for unused items in original packaging.

settings.question: Can I change my order after it has shipped?
settings.answer: If your order has not yet shipped, we can usually make changes. Please contact support as soon as possible.
